seo.title: Beacon | Books-First Discovery Reputation
seo.description: Beacon is a books-first discovery and reputation network where curators make public recommendations and supporters record early conviction.

footer.description: Beacon is a books-first discovery and reputation network. Participation records conviction and curation history; it is not a promise of profit or passive yield.

home.title: Find the books before everyone else does.
home.description: Beacon is an early-access discovery network for readers who like trying new ideas first. Curators open book signals, supporters record conviction, and reputation forms in public.

signal.title: The Long Attention Field Guide
signal.thesis: A strange, useful book for people who think attention is becoming infrastructure.
signal.meta: Curated by Ari Chen. Support is a participation signal, not a refundable vote or promised return.

reasons.title: For readers who like finding the signal first.

early.title: Beat the feed
early.description: Track books before popularity, ads, or algorithms make them obvious.

public.title: Build a taste trail
public.description: Your early support and curation history become visible reputation, not private app data.

constrained.title: Start with books
constrained.description: Beacon is deliberately books-first so the experiment stays focused, legible, and reviewable.

how.title: Open a signal. Back a thesis. Leave a record.
how.description: Beacon keeps the loop small enough to understand before you connect a wallet.

recommend.title: Curate
recommend.description: A curator creates the canonical book signal and locks a documented SOL stake behind the recommendation.

support.title: Support
support.description: Readers support with a small SOL contribution to record early conviction and participation order.

reputation.title: Remember
reputation.description: The page shows who discovered early and who backed the signal while the recommendation was still under the radar.

ledger.title: The wallet moment should feel boringly clear.
ledger.description: Before signing, Beacon shows the action, amount, recipient route, and network. The ledger is part of the product experience, not a hidden implementation detail.
ledger.notice: Support is not presented as a refundable vote, guaranteed return, or passive yield product.
ledger.previewDescription: Representative preview for a future support flow.

action.label: Action
action.note: Adds public participation to this book signal.

recipient.label: Recipient
recipient.note: The program route and accounts are shown before signing.

amount.label: Amount
amount.note: Contribution amount; network fees are listed separately.

cluster.label: Cluster
cluster.note: Network context is explicit to avoid accidental mainnet actions.

final.title: Try the book discovery network before it is obvious.

auth.signupTitle: Join the first readers testing Beacon.
